prompt: DUB-20 removes the findBranchingBlockers rejection in dub submit --path stack and the matching submit-branching-blocker doctor issue so tree-shaped stacks (a parent with multiple children) walk natively. This is the foundational Tier 1 change other stacked-tree features depend on. Reviewers should confirm parent-before-children ordering, deterministic sibling order by branch name, --fix preserved as a no-op alias with a deprecation warning, and no other commands regress on linear stacks.
tldr: Drops the submit branching-blocker rejection, sorts siblings deterministically, keeps --fix as a deprecated no-op, and adds a 3-sibling tree integration test.

motivation: Tier 1 — Branching Stack Support depends on submit walking trees instead of rejecting them.
doctor was duplicating the same blocker as a user-visible issue, which would have outlived the submit rejection if not removed together.
before: dub submit --path stack threw 'Branching stacks are not supported by submit' on any tree.
dub doctor surfaced a submit-branching-blocker issue for tree stacks, contradicting the new design.
topologicalOrder preserved insertion order for siblings, so sibling order was non-deterministic across runs.
after: dub submit --path stack walks tree stacks natively in BFS order (parent first, siblings sorted by branch name).
dub doctor no longer reports submit-branching-blocker; the issue code is removed from DoctorIssueCode.
--fix prints a one-line deprecation warning and otherwise behaves identically, so existing scripts keep working.

fileTour.explanation: Removes SubmitBranchingBlocker, findBranchingBlockers, buildBranchingError, fallbackApplied, and the blocker throw in getSubmitPlan. Adds a deprecation log line when --fix is passed. SubmitPlan/SubmitResult shed the fallbackApplied field.
Drops 'submit-branching-blocker' from DoctorIssueCode, removes the blocker loop in doctor(), and deletes the local findBranchingBlockers helper. doctor no longer flags tree stacks as unhealthy.
topologicalOrder now sorts each parent's children alphabetically before BFS enqueue so submit/restack walk trees deterministically.
Updates --fix option text to '[deprecated] No-op alias kept for script compatibility' on both submit and ss aliases; rewrites the stale example referencing 'safe auto-remediation'.

New integration test: 3-sibling tree (main → feat/alpha, feat/bravo, feat/charlie). Asserts deterministic ordering, parent-first BFS, --path current isolation, and that the legacy branching-blocker error is no longer thrown.
Replaces the 'throws when stack has branching children' and 'falls back with --fix' assertions with positive tree-submit coverage and a --fix deprecation-warning assertion.
Swaps the 'detects submit branching blockers' case for a positive 'does not flag branching stacks' assertion.

reviewFocus.title: Deterministic sibling order via topologicalOrder
reviewFocus.rationale: New alphabetical sort runs once per parent's children. Confirm restack and stack-maintenance, which share this helper, do not depend on prior insertion order semantics.

reviewFocus.rationale: Verify the union literal is gone, the local helper is removed, and no other doctor branch produces the obsolete code.

reviewFocus.rationale: Existing scripts must still parse --fix without error; the option text and submit() warning should make the deprecation explicit.
